title: Withdrawal, Move-Out and Closing of an Apartment Home Lease
content:
An Apartment Home Lease ends in one of three ways: the applicant withdraws before possession, possession ends at move-out, or — after move-out — the lease record is closed. The resident handbook states each as follows.

## Withdrawal before possession

An applicant may withdraw only before taking possession; withdrawal is the applicant's own signed act. The application fee is never refunded, and once the lease is approved the administration fee is forfeited as well. A withdrawal also cancels the pending Lease Term Agreement and the Security Deposit Account under their own charters. After possession has begun, leaving before the term ends is an early termination or lease break under the Lease Term Agreement charter, never a withdrawal.

| Stage at withdrawal | Application fee | Administration fee |
|---|---|---|
| Applied, not yet approved | not refunded | — |
| Approved, before move-in | not refunded | forfeited |
| After move-in | withdrawal not available | — |

## Move-out

Possession ends — and move-out is recorded with its move-out date — on the earliest of these days:
- the day all keys and fobs are returned;
- the day abandonment is confirmed after the abandonment notice period of the state has run;
- the day a writ of possession is executed.

| State of the community | Abandonment notice period (days) |
|---|---|
| California (CA) | 18 |
| Washington (WA) | 7 |
| Colorado (CO) | 15 |
| Texas (TX) | 2 |
| Georgia (GA) | 7 |
| Arizona (AZ) | 7 |

The move-out date starts the move-out review of the deposit account and the final billing of every add-on and utility account tied to the lease (Parking License, Storage Rental, Pet Addendum and Utility Services Program accounts).

## Closing

A lease is closed only after the deposit account for the lease has its final account statement issued. This is read from the company's record of the Security Deposit Account opened for the same lease, which must show its final statement issued (disposition issued, in collections or closed).

Closing never erases a balance: whatever remains on the lease ledger is carried into the final account statement.

*Hypothetical:* keys returned on 5 August while a writ of possession is scheduled for 9 August — possession ends on 5 August, the earlier of the two days.
